name: 05-slot-lag
sql: select slot_name, plugin, slot_type, active, restart_lsn::text as restart_lsn, confirmed_flush_lsn::text as confirmed_flush_lsn, pg_current_wal_lsn()::text as current_wal_lsn, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), restart_lsn) as retained_bytes_from_restart, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), confirmed_flush_lsn) as lag_bytes_from_confirmed, wal_status from pg_replication_slots order by slot_name
